title.quote: PhotoBot: Reference-Guided Interactive Photography via Natural Language
title.justification: Title as given on the paper
title.value: PhotoBot: Reference-Guided Interactive Photography via Natural Language

extractions.description: The paper presents PhotoBot, a robotic photography framework that uses a VLM and object detector to caption a curated gallery of reference images, an LLM to retrieve relevant references from a user's natural language query, and DINO-ViT semantic correspondences with a PnP solver (MAGSAC++/RANSAC) to adjust an RGB-D camera mounted on a Franka Emika manipulator. User studies and ablations on RANSAC thresholds and number of keypoints are reported.

type.quote: We demonstrate our approach using a manipulator equipped with a wrist camera. Our user studies show that photos taken by PhotoBot are often more aesthetically pleasing than those taken by users themselves
type.justification: The work builds a system and evaluates it with real robot experiments and user studies.

name.quote: We evaluated PhotoBot using a real Franka Emika robot manipulator equipped with a RealSense D435 RGB-D camera.
name.justification: The paper builds a robot photographer system with a manipulator.

name.quote: we exploit pretrained features from a vision transformer capable of capturing semantic similarity across marked appearance variations
name.justification: Semantic keypoint correspondence, PnP, vision transformers.

name.quote: much of the prior work has focused on the technical navigation and control problems and not on the social aspect (i.e., the interaction between the photographer and human subject) as tackled in our work.
name.justification: The paper focuses on interaction between the photographer robot and human subject and runs user studies.
